summary: Context-only committee read: the displayed tape remains risk-on, but the macro foundation is internally unstable. The confirmed US label is Q2 Reflation at low confidence (0.196), while the raw growth/inflation axes have indicated Q3 for 4 of the required 7 sessions. Liquidity is contracting in an orderly drain, the RRP buffer is exhausted, and credit is the only warm scare still climbing. This does not justify escalation: the Risk Radar is only WATCH, has no confirmed validated hot leg, and its measured 21-session pullback rate is 13.0% versus a 17.8% base rate. Breadth remains broadly healthy above the 200-day measure, volatility is normalizing, and no recession signal is active. Factor evidence is immature: only 11 panel dates, no Pair G records, no factor-attention history, and no surviving tradeable composite. The spine/kernel review also argues for restraint: many board/kernel outcomes are unsigned MFE proxies or rely on vacuous held-out comparisons, while several signed-excess families are negative or unarmed. One conditional regime hypothesis was registered for future metabolism; it is proposal material, not a claim or signal.
what_fired: Four shadow attention records were written: unresolved US regime-label/credit divergence; conflict between the open China-equities overweight thesis and current China/HK conditions; overdue open-thesis scoring backlog; and rising put-skew contradiction across 13 US buy-lane names.

One hypothesis was registered: test whether unsupported US regime labels combined with contracting liquidity are associated with at least 0.5 percentage point weaker five-day signed excess after a minimum of 30 eligible observations.
contradictions_review: The graph contains two current contradictions. First, ticker-level demand-versus-supply divergences remain present in the briefing plane; this is descriptive and not directional authority. Second, 13 US buy-lane names have rising five-day OTM-put skew. That options evidence may de-escalate confidence only; the graph explicitly notes that bullish skew deceleration is unsupported on sector history, so no opposite position follows. Pair G is dormant because the factor panel has only 11 dates and requires at least 60. ADB-W3 review found a material conflict in the open China-equities overweight thesis: China and Hong Kong are both Q4 growth-scare with contracting liquidity, Hong Kong's peg is on the weak side, and southbound flow is negative despite hot turnover. Numerous theses also remain open past their check-by dates, which weakens accountability until scored or retired.
decaying_families: US Board: signed excess weakened from positive Q1 readings to negative Q2 readings at five and ten days; the engine remains unarmed because pooled out-of-sample performance loses.
Radar: negative shrunken signed excess at five and 21 days, including weaker Q2 five-day behavior; unarmed.
Policy and White House families: negative signed excess across available horizons and small or moderate effective samples; unarmed.
AI, stock, and thematic desks: negative 63-day signed excess in Q1, Q2, and pooled estimates; held by vacuous single-member tail comparisons.
Alt-data: five-day readings are mildly positive but pooled out-of-sample performance is negative; 21-day Q1 signed excess is negative; unarmed.
Factor composite: non-tradeable, with investment, low-volatility, low-beta, and composite legs carrying negative historical IC; scorecard is explicitly survivorship-biased.
deserves_operator: US regime transition/credit divergence: clear only if Q3 completes 7/7 confirmation sessions or raw axes return to supporting Q2, and credit stress stops climbing for three consecutive sessions.
China-equities overweight thesis mb-2026-07-09-1: conflict clears only if China exits Q4 into Q1/Q2, the HK peg leaves weak-side outflow, and southbound flow is no longer materially negative.
Open-thesis backlog: within three days, score, retire, or explicitly extend every thesis whose check-by date is on or before 2026-08-21 with an immutable rationale.
Options skew versus US buy lane: clear only if the affected cohort's five-day OTM-put skew stops rising for three consecutive observations or the names leave the buy lane.
Factor coverage remains insufficient for Pair G or attention authority: do not infer absence of contradictions from an absent ledger; the panel must reach at least 60 distinct dates.

Data-quality caveat: options-flow history is immature and has unfillable missing live-snapshot sessions; several external sources are failed or stale. Treat apparent quiet in those legs as missing coverage, not confirmation.
